source: Nouns Still Dominate Both Lists, Verbs Remained Steady, and Adjectives Grew Modestly.
why: Under the chart note's stated definition — all changes reflect each category's share of its list, not raw counts — verbs are not steady: they fall from 3.1% of the 1953 list to 2.5% of the 2023 list. Verbs are steady only in raw counts (70 vs. 69), a definition the story says it is not using.
